commits.message:
feat(docs): a card shows its setup locked, labelled by origin, folded on docs pages (rich-example-card-obsb.skf)

The card's editor now holds the whole program its block runs as: the setup
above it, in groups labelled by where they came from ("imports", "assumed by
every example", "assumed on this page", "from '<heading>'"), the block, and the
braces closing the setup's scopes. Everything but the block is locked: a change
reaching into it, typed, pasted or deleted, changes nothing. On a docs page the
setup is folded into one strip, "▸ N lines of setup", shown while the editor
has focus; a click unfolds it. A thrown error's line is the program's line, so
it counts the setup.

- theme/setup-regions.ts: the locked, labelled, foldable setup as one
  CodeMirror extension; where it starts (folded/unfolded) is the caller's, for
  the playground (A5).
- example-slice.ts: "Try it" and the card's setup are cut from one parts list.
  The card's setup imports only what the block names and does not import
  itself, so a block that imports what it uses has no setup at all
  (rich-example-card-obsb.021). aroundBlock is gone.
- example-markers.ts: each fence carries the heading it sits under.
docs(introduction): an edited example's Try it opens the edit (rich-example-card-obsb.lz3) (#352)
